headline: Crypto Liquidations Reach $1.57 Billion Following Binance Hack and Token Declines
summary: Cryptocurrency futures liquidations jumped to $1.57 billion as a reported $6.3 billion Binance hack pushed bitcoin and ether lower, with bitcoin trading near $77,350.
why: Sudden security breaches on major cryptocurrency exchanges trigger rapid market liquidations, high volatility, and systemic risk concerns across digital asset markets.
why_moved: Security incidents at major exchanges trigger automatic margin liquidations and widespread selling pressure across digital asset tokens.
